tool.name: Generate Shopify Product Image
tool.description: Generate 1 new Shopify product image using a reference product image (URL or data URL) + a prompt, via google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview.

image.description: Alias for imageUrl/imageDataUrl. Provide either an http(s) URL or a data URL.

prompt.description: Instruction describing what to render using the reference product image.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible http(s) URL of the Shopify product image.

imageDataUrl.description: Data URL for the product image (data:image/...;base64,...) if not using imageUrl.
